# jira_project_permission_scheme (Resource)

Assigns a permission scheme to a Jira project. Every project must have a permission scheme; deleting this resource resets the project to the default permission scheme.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jira_permission_scheme" "editors" {
  name        = "Project Editors"
  description = "Permission scheme for project editors"
}

// Assign a permission scheme to a project
resource "jira_project_permission_scheme" "my_project" {
  project_key = "MYPROJ"
  scheme_id   = jira_permission_scheme.editors.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) The key of the project to assign the permission scheme to
- `scheme_id` (Number) The ID of the permission scheme to assign to the project

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `scheme_name` (String) The name of the assigned permission scheme

## Import

Import is supported using the project key:

```shell
terraform import jira_project_permission_scheme.example MYPROJ
```
